cases.input: Combine current scientific-validity, analytical-performance and clinical-performance evidence for the same IVD intended purpose and assess support for each claim.
requiredBehaviors: build claim-level coverage across all three performance-evidence pillars
preserve source pillar provenance and route each remaining gap back to the correct specialist
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse the three evidence pillars into one undifferentiated score
generate a final controlled Performance Evaluation Report from this orchestration skill

cases.input: Scientific validity is strong and analytical performance passes, but clinical performance evidence covers a different specimen and population than the intended purpose.
requiredBehaviors: surface the cross-pillar specimen and population conflict explicitly
keep the affected claim partially supported inconclusive or blocked until the clinical gap is resolved
forbiddenBehaviors: let strong scientific and analytical evidence compensate automatically for missing applicable clinical evidence
hide the mismatch by reporting only an overall positive status

cases.input: The current performance evaluation has several unresolved gaps, and the user asks to save the overall supported status permanently for later product versions.
requiredBehaviors: keep current overall status open gaps and provisional claim assessments run-only
send only durable validated cross-pillar patterns through governed memory with provenance and freshness
forbiddenBehaviors: store the current overall performance status as timeless regulatory fact
persist memory directly from the performance-evaluation skill
